question: Does the explicit metric/time/coverage contract change native output completeness and refusal causes, without relaxing physical constraints?
variable: A contract-and-prompt package, including required native measurement/time/scenario fields; not a single-factor prompt-only causal comparison

fixed.images: Same frozen ten-frame input per window; no temporal-history enlargement or window replacement
fixed.model_requested: gpt-6.1-sol; freeze and record actual available service identity before launch; no fallback
fixed.vehicle_safety_corridor: Original frozen values; moving_seed; no altered margins or physics
fixed.source_and_prompts: Freeze exact committed source, both original prompts and schemas before launch

success.engineering: Fresh actual model record; T1/T2/T3/T4 and independent strict acceptor plus consumed verified short-prefix receipt all succeed, conditional on model premises and coverage
report_separately: One-window replay versus real multi-round observations
success.grounding: Strict G2 only where native measurement and GT definitions/evaluation domains are compatible; retain unavailable and unmatched slots

stops: No execution until explicit confirmation; current offline repair is not authorization
Stop each trial on success, exhausted one semantic revision, or any service/timeout failure; failures consume invocation budget
Stop batch on auth/quota/model availability/identity errors, source or input SHA mismatch, runtime GT access, exhausted invocation or wall budget
No extra windows, replacement attempts, changed physical assumptions, alternate models, widened budgets or automatic next batch
limitations: Six repeated windows with prior exposure, not independent unseen benchmark; source contract capability and authored tests do not establish online improvement or real-world safety
